name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a sharp, calculating stare, a faint cunning smirk.
components.effects: Faint tendrils of {{MAGIC}} toxic mist curl and drift low around her feet, glowing faintly in the dark. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Venomis, visible drifting through the shadows nearby, an Elder Dragon of toxic-orchid-magenta and tarnished-brass scales, wreathed in drifting toxic mist, wings like tattered sheets veined in vibrant acid-lime

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
